summary.text: Mark Tisdel is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 55 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Mark Tisdel's general-election opponent is Alex Hawkins (D).
He has worked as a medical liability insurance agent and chairs the Financial Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mark Tisdel was born in Port Huron, Michigan, lives in Rochester Hills, Michigan, and earned a bachelor's degree from Drake University in 1978.
His career experience includes working as a medical liability insurance agent and as a principal at Backus Payne & Associates.
Tisdel has volunteered with the Rotary Club, the Chamber of Commerce, the Small Business Association of Michigan, and the Better Business Bureau.
In 2025-2026 Tisdel chairs the Financial Services Committee, is Majority Vice Chair of the Insurance Committee, and also serves on the Health Policy and House Regulatory Reform committees.
